supportPage.title: Support

items.q: Is this the same app as MyQuickPaste for Windows?
items.a: No. MyQuickPaste is the smartphone edition. It shares the same product philosophy but is a separate app with its own data and store purchase.

items.q: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
items.a: Free lets you save up to 10 items per text category, 10 images, and 2 profiles. Copy, save, search, reorder, and quick save are available with no time limit. Pro raises the limits to 200 items per text category, 50 images, and 30 profiles, and adds .mqp backup export/import, premium themes, and custom category names and icons.

items.q: Is there a time limit on Free?
items.a: No. Free can be used without a time limit. Pro is an optional one-time purchase for higher save limits, backups, premium themes, and category customization.
Saved text, profile cards, and settings are stored only on your device.

items.q: How do I back up or move my data?
items.a: With Pro, you can export an .mqp backup from Settings and import it on another device running MyQuickPaste.

items.q: When will the iPhone version be available?
items.a: The iOS edition is in preparation. This page will be updated when it launches on the App Store.
Open the Pro upgrade screen in the app. On Android, the purchase is processed by Google Play. Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

sections.p: MyQuickPaste is a smartphone app provided by Good Rabbit inc. ("we", "us", or "our"). This policy explains how MyQuickPaste handles information on your device.

MyQuickPaste does not include any process that collects, transmits, or stores on servers operated by us the free text, snippets, email addresses, phone numbers, profiles, images, or clipboard contents you use in the app. This content is processed on your device to provide the app's features. However, when you explicitly use a sharing feature, when Android backup operates, or when you use store services such as Google Play, data is handled according to the mechanisms and policies of the relevant operating system or service.

Entered content, categories, profiles, app settings, and saved images are stored in the app's private storage area on your device. Saved images are copied into that private app storage. On Android, if the operating system's backup feature is enabled, some app data may be backed up to and restored from backup storage associated with your Google Account. Under the app's current backup rules, saved image files are excluded from cloud backup. During device-to-device transfer, data may be transferred through operating-system features.

Saved data is stored in an app-private area protected by the operating system. We do not operate our own server for storing your saved content. The security of the device itself, operating-system backups, and backup files you export depends on the security and management of the relevant device, service, and user-controlled storage.

To show previews on the main screen and provide related features, MyQuickPaste may read text or images currently stored in your device's clipboard. Clipboard content is processed on the device and is not automatically stored permanently unless you explicitly save it. The app may create a temporary cache file to preview clipboard images. MyQuickPaste does not include any process that sends clipboard content to servers operated by us.

Saved data remains in the app's storage area on your device until you delete it in the app or uninstall the app. Uninstalling removes the app's local data from the device, but copies may remain separately in Android operating-system backups or in backup files that you exported and retained. With Pro, you can export and import data as a MyQuickPaste backup file (.mqp). You choose where an exported file is saved, and you are responsible for managing and deleting exported backup files.

sections.h: App stores, purchases, and external services
sections.p: Distribution of the Android edition and Pro purchases are handled through Google Play, and Google Play Billing is used to verify purchases. Pro is a one-time in-app purchase and is not a subscription. We do not directly receive credit card numbers or other payment card details. The app does not use third-party SDKs for analytics or advertising. When you use Google Play purchase or review features, or external features you choose such as sharing, email, or a web browser, the privacy policies and terms of the relevant services apply. The iOS edition is currently in development, and this policy will be updated as needed when its distribution and purchase implementation is finalized.
If you have any questions about this policy, please contact us at myquickpaste@hotmail.com.
